svg.aria-label: The map style sheet fetched from the bathymetry tile host points its glyphs field at a third-party font server, so the label layer fetches glyph PBFs from an origin that was on no allowlist, while the tile host and the tide API host were both already allowed.

svg.text: Three external origins, two on the allowlist
